# Agewise

> Free age and date calculators in English, Arabic, Japanese and for the Nepali (Bikram Sambat) calendar. All calculations run in the browser.

## Calculators

- [Age Calculator – Age as on Any Date from Date of Birth](https://www.example.com/): Free age calculator: find your exact age from date of birth in years, months and days, today or as on any date. Checks exam and job age limits.
- [حساب العمر بالهجري والميلادي | احسب عمرك بدقة](https://www.example.com/ar/): احسب عمرك بالهجري والميلادي بدقة وسهولة. اكتشف عمرك بالسنوات والأشهر والأيام، وتاريخ ميلادك بالهجري، وكم باقي على عيد ميلادك القادم.
- [年齢早見表 2026年（令和8年）版｜年齢計算・干支・和暦](https://www.example.com/ja/): 2026年（令和8年）の年齢早見表。生まれ年ごとの満年齢・和暦（令和・平成・昭和）・干支が一覧でわかります。生年月日から満年齢と数え年も計算できます。
- [Age Difference Calculator – Years, Months and Days Between Two People](https://www.example.com/age-difference/): Find the exact age difference between two people in years, months and days. Enter two dates of birth to see who is older and by how much.
- [Chronological Age Calculator – Years;Months;Days for Testing](https://www.example.com/chronological-age-calculator/): Find chronological age in years;months;days (e.g. 8;5;19) from birth date and test date, with the 30-day method and adjusted age for prematurity.
- [Agniveer Age Limit 2026–27 Calculator – Army and Air Force](https://www.example.com/age-limit/agniveer/): Agniveer age limit by date of birth: Army Agniveer 2026–27 (17½ to 22, born 1 July 2005 to 1 July 2009) and Air Force Agniveervayu intakes 01/2027 and 02/2027.
- [CDS Age Limit 2026–27 Calculator – IMA, INA, AFA and OTA](https://www.example.com/age-limit/cds/): CDS age limit by academy: IMA and INA 19–24, AFA 20–24 (26 with a CPL), OTA 19–25. Check your date of birth for CDS (I) 2027 and see the CDS (II) 2026 dates.
- [NDA Age Limit 2026–27 Calculator – Date of Birth Eligibility](https://www.example.com/age-limit/nda/): NDA age limit by date of birth: NDA (II) 2026 needed births from 1 January 2008 to 1 January 2011. Check NDA (I) and (II) 2027 eligibility for boys and girls.
- [SSC Age Limit 2026–27 Calculator – GD and CGL with Relaxation](https://www.example.com/age-limit/ssc/): SSC GD age limit 18–23 on 1 January and SSC CGL post groups 18–27, 18–30, 18–32 and 20–30 on 1 August. Check your eligibility with OBC, SC/ST and PwBD relaxation.
- [UPSC Age Limit 2026–27 Calculator – Category Relaxation and Attempts](https://www.example.com/age-limit/upsc/): UPSC Civil Services age limit: 21 to under 32 on 1 August, plus 3 years for OBC, 5 for SC/ST and 10 for PwBD. Check your eligibility and exam years by date of birth.
- [Nepali Date Converter – BS to AD and AD to BS](https://www.example.com/nepali-date-converter/): Convert Nepali (Bikram Sambat) dates to English (AD) dates and back, with the weekday. See today's Nepali date. Covers 2000–2090 BS.
- [Nepali Age Calculator – Age in BS and AD (Bikram Sambat)](https://www.example.com/nepali-age-calculator/): Calculate your exact age in Bikram Sambat (BS) and AD. Enter a BS or AD date of birth to convert it and see your age in years, months and days.
- [حساب فرق العمر بين شخصين بالهجري والميلادي](https://www.example.com/ar/age-difference/): احسب فرق العمر بين شخصين بالسنوات والأشهر والأيام بالتقويم الميلادي والهجري. أدخل تاريخَي الميلاد لتعرف من الأكبر وبكم.
- [学年早見表 2026年度（令和8年度）｜生年月日から学年・入学卒業年](https://www.example.com/ja/gakunen/): 2026年度（令和8年度）の学年早見表。年少から大学4年生まで、学年ごとの生年月日の範囲がわかります。生年月日を入れると今の学年と小学校・中学校・高校・大学の入学・卒業年を計算します。
